name: benchmark_mathlib_new_compiled
description: A compiled benchmark derived from the Lean mathlib library for evaluating automated theorem proving and proof-synthesis models. It measures a model's ability to reproduce formal proofs from mathlib given theorem statements and contexts; success is determined by automated proof checking in the Lean environment. The dataset is intended to advance neural approaches to formal proof generation and verification.
reputation: Well-regarded within the formal-methods and theorem-proving research communities as a realistic test for Lean proof synthesis.
